47. Numbers Repeated K Times

50

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N,K and an array of N elements, print the number(s) that has been repeated K times.Print them in ascending order if there are more than one number to be printed.If no element satisfies the pattern then print -1
input_spec: The input consists of two integers N and K, followed by an array of N elements. N and K are up to 100000.
output_spec: Print the numbers that have been repeated K times in ascending order. If no such element exists, print -1.
